title: Receipt
description: The log's answer to an append: where the entry sits, and the digest of the entry as appended: SHA-256 of the entry's RFC 8785 canonical JSON, as this contract serialises it. A receipt exists only once the entry is durable, and an action takes effect only after its receipt (INV-7).

index.description: The entry's position in it, from 0.

entry.description: The SHA-256 digest of the entry's RFC 8785 canonical JSON.
